Welcome to Doctolib
×

We and our partners place cookies, access and use non-sensitive information from your device to improve our products and personalize ads and other contents throughout this website. You may accept all or part of these operations. To learn more about cookies, partners, and how we use your data, to review your options or these operations for each partner, visit our privacy policy.

You allow
+Necessary Cookies

These cookies are strictly necessary for the proper functioning of the site, for the proper execution of the services that you request, as well as for the conservation of your consent to the deposit of other categories of cookies.

This purpose is required by our website to operate normally and cannot be disabled.

Required
+Analytics

Allow the use of analytics cookies to enable us to understand how you reach our websites and to measure their usage in order to evaluate their performance and help us improve the quality of our services.

+Prevention Campaign Measurement

These cookies and trackers allow us to collect additional browsing data from our website in order to measure the performance of prevention campaigns, generate statistical reports, and help us improve the quality of our services. These cookies and trackers are present on: doctolib.fr, about.doctolib.fr

+Content Personalization

These cookies allow us to display personalized Doctolib content based on the user's profile.

+Prevention Campaign Personalization

These cookies allow us to display personalized prevention campaigns based on the user's profile.

+Advertising campaign audiences

Doctolib uses cookies to measure the audience and analyze the effectiveness of its advertising campaign on your site.

+Analytics with personal health data

These cookies and trackers enable us to collect data, including personal health data without the user being directly identifiable to us, on the navigation of our website and app (such as, appointments taken on the Doctolib Platform) for purposes of analysis and statistical reports and to improve our products and services, including artificial intelligence tools.

Set all your preferences to save and continue

Doctolib and its partners use cookies or similar technologies. By clicking on "Accept", you hereby consent to the use of these technologies in order to optimize the user experience, improve the website, personalize the content displayed, perform audience measurements and statistical studies and offer you personalized advertising, including on social networks.Please take the time to review our cookie policy.
